video_summary.overall_goal: View WiFi network analyzer data (access points, channel ratings, and signal graphs)
video_summary.description: User navigates WiFi Analyzer app, viewing different analysis tabs and displays

steps.system_response: App displays access points list with ThodoSaSignal network highlighted
steps.visual_feedback: List showing multiple WiFi networks with signal strength icons

steps.system_response: Switches to channel rating view showing star ratings per channel
steps.visual_feedback: Colored star ratings displayed for different WiFi channels

steps.visual_feedback: Colorful bar chart showing signal distribution by channel

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Channel graph with finger touching/pointing at specific channel
steps.system_response: Shows detailed information about selected channel when touched
steps.visual_feedback: Information card appears above graph showing channel details

steps.system_response: Dialog popup with detailed network information appears
steps.visual_feedback: Modal dialog with copyable text and quick share option

steps.system_response: Left navigation drawer opens showing all app options
steps.visual_feedback: Drawer slides in from left showing menu items

steps.visual_feedback: Menu item highlight or selection indication

steps.system_response: Android bottom sheet with sharing options appears

steps.visual_feedback: Selection highlight on chosen share destination
steps.intent_task: Share WiFi data with Best Deals app

steps.system_response: Returns to channel graph screen after share action completes

overall_flow: Tap Channel Rating tab to view channel quality ratings
Tap Channel Graph tab to view signal spectrum distribution
Long-press on graph area to view channel details
Dialog popup shows network metadata with copy/share options
Tap hamburger menu to open navigation drawer
Tap share button which opens Android share sheet
Select app for sharing (e.g., Best Deals)
Return to graph view after share completes
human_readable_step_summary: App displays initial access points list with WiFi networks
User taps Channel Rating tab to view star ratings for different frequencies
User taps Channel Graph tab to switch to frequency spectrum visualization
User long-presses on the channel graph to view detailed information about a specific channel
Modal dialog appears showing network metadata, timestamps, and copyable information
User taps hamburger menu icon to open left navigation drawer
Navigation menu is displayed with options for Access Points, Channel Rating, Time Graph, Export, Available Channels, Vendors, Settings, and About
User interacts with menu items or taps a share/options button
Android bottom sheet appears with available apps for sharing the data
User taps on Best Deals (or another app) to share the WiFi network information
App returns to channel graph view, sharing action completes with visual feedback
